name: Kaph Kuthar Ras

sections.overview: Kaph Kuthar Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Kaph Kuthar Ras is one of the known ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This is known to treat problems related with cough and phlegm.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddh parad – Calcinated and purified mercury 
 Shuddha gandhaka – Calcinated and purified sulphur 
 Saunth – Zingiber officinale 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Tamra bhasma – Calcinated and purified copper 
 Loha bhsama – Calcinated and purified iron 
 Kateli – Solanum surattense 
 Kutki – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Dhattura – Datura stramonium 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients in equal quantity. 
 Take mercury and Sulphur, mix till the minerals lose its shine and form like kajali. 
 Now mix this kajali with loha and tamra bhsama mixture. 
 Take the ingredients saunth, pippali and maricha. Powder the ingredients and mix with kateli flower’s juice in mortar pestle for 6 hours. 
 After then tincture with kutki’s kwath and dhattura’s leaves. 
 Now take the paste up to 125 mg and make its pills.
sections.dose: One to two pills with nagarbael’s (piper betle) water.
sections.indications:
Chest congestion 
 Kapha fever 
 Phlegm 
 Breathlessness
sections.contraindications:
Take medicine under medical prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Kaph Kuthar Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 
 Introduction 
 Kaph Kuthar Ras is one of the known ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This is known to treat problems related with cough and phlegm. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddh parad – Calcinated and purified mercury 
 Shuddha gandhaka – Calcinated and purified sulphur 
 Saunth – Zingiber officinale 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Tamra bhasma – Calcinated and purified copper 
 Loha bhsama – Calcinated and purified iron 
 Kateli – Solanum surattense 
 Kutki – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Dhattura – Datura stramonium 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients in equal quantity. 
 Take mercury and Sulphur, mix till the minerals lose its shine and form like kajali. 
 Now mix this kajali with loha and tamra bhsama mixture. 
 Take the ingredients saunth, pippali and maricha. Powder the ingredients and mix with kateli flower’s juice in mortar pestle for 6 hours. 
 After then tincture with kutki’s kwath and dhattura’s leaves. 
 Now take the paste up to 125 mg and make its pills. 
 
 Dose 
 One to two pills with nagarbael’s (piper betle) water. 
 Indications 
 
 Chest congestion 
 Kapha fever 
 Phlegm 
 Breathlessness 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take medicine under medical prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
